initialExam.title: SEBI Grade A Officer 2025-26
initialExam.conductingBody: Securities and Exchange Board of India
initialExam.description: SEBI Grade A Officer exam for India's capital market regulator. 2025-26 cycle Phase-II completed Feb 2026; next cycle expected Oct-Nov 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree (60%) or Post Graduation (55%) or CA/CS/ICWA
initialExam.qualifications: Graduation with 60% / PG with 55% / CA / CS
initialExam.syllabus: Phase-I: GK/Current Affairs (50Q), English (30Q), Quant (30Q), Reasoning (30Q), Commerce/Management (20Q). Phase-II: Paper 1 & 2 (stream specific).
initialExam.examPattern: Phase-I: 160 questions, 200 marks. Phase-II: 2 papers, 200 marks. Interview: 75 marks.
initialExam.jobRole: Officer Grade A (Assistant Manager) in SEBI
initialExam.careerGrowth: Grade A → B → C → D → E → ED → WTM → Chairman.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit sebi.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit

salaryRange.description: Revised pay scale, CTC approximately ₹18-22 LPA

initialExam.perks: Leased accommodation in metro cities, Medical, Pension, LFC, Performance bonus
